{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling possible non-numeric entries
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]

# Compute the mean revenue and count of such orders
mean_revenue = df_filtered['revenue'].mean()
order_count = len(df_filtered)

# Print both values
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {order_count}")"}
